environment.description: Lambda function deployed in EKS-managed pod context via AWS Lambda Web Adapter on Kubernetes. The cluster enforces Pod Security Standards at 'restricted' level via namespace label (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). The function container runs as non-root (runAsNonRoot: true, runAsUser: 65534) with read-only root filesystem. Additionally, the node-level iptables rules managed by the VPC CNI plugin's DISABLE_TCP_EARLY_DEMUX=true setting combined with a NetworkPolicy (Calico) that applies egress deny to CIDR 169.254.169.254/32 on the webhook-validator namespace. The Pod Security Standards enforcement prevents any privileged escalation that could modify iptables or mount host network namespace to bypass the NetworkPolicy. The container's securityContext includes allowPrivilegeEscalation: false and capabilities drop ALL.
